actual_scope: Do the open candidates PR3934 (hosted receivers) and PR3955 (hosted frame selection), whose complex root PR3939, PR3958 and PR3959 reuse, preserve the exact eight-stream physical operator with their literal MOVES files?
scope_change_reason: The highest open kappa claims (PR3934 to PR3959, up to 0.0017367) stack on PR3251, which its author retracted on 2026-10-18 after PR3296/PR3311. No comment on the open chain records this. Binding the existing exact replay to their literal moves is the missing check before anyone builds on them.
bottleneck_link: Every kappa gain of PR3934-PR3959 over PR3148 on the complex side comes from idle-axis moves. If those moves change the physical operator, the claims are not supported and the complex side falls back to PR3148 (about 0.0017298).
stop_rule: Stop at literal, source-bound replays of the vendored moves and the owner-0 frame-selection ports that need no new assumption; do not attempt repairs, a new construction or the reselected ports.
evidence: verify.py: PR3934 contains all 435,604 moves of the retracted PR3251; PR3934 and PR3955 contain PR3296's witness moves (0,0,14->8 and 15->10, axis 2^72). Each of PR3934's 2,374 new moves, all into hosted receivers, changes the exact operator at its own (owner, port): 2,274 configurations over 140 owner replicas, none preserved; in 920 of them these are the only moves at that owner and port. At owner replica 0, 55 of PR3955's 112 ports donate only literal remainder axes (identity selection); all 55 change the operator, including port 0. The other 57 ports use reselected frames whose cell-to-axis map PR3955 does not state, so they are not replayed.
